summary: Review infrastructure-as-code for privilege boundaries, destructive change paths, state, rollout and recovery evidence without pretending static IaC review proves deployed state.

must_inspect.why: IaC can encode broad credentials or workload permissions that expand blast radius.
false_positive_guards: Do not treat a wildcard-looking declaration as exploitable without understanding the resource/action scope and deployment context.

must_inspect.why: Schema, storage, network and identity changes can be irreversible or cause outage if replacement semantics are misunderstood.
false_positive_guards: A replace operation is not automatically unsafe when redundancy and migration controls are explicit.

must_inspect.why: Infrastructure automation depends on state integrity, rollback or forward-fix procedures and observable rollout health.
false_positive_guards: Do not require rollback when the documented strategy is tested forward-fix with bounded blast radius.
Static IaC is not proof of the currently deployed environment.
